spans.text: Field data (28-day Chrome user average) is more representative than lab data (single Lighthouse run). Use lab data as fallback when CrUX returns 404 (insufficient traffic).
spans.note: The prompt emphasizes using field data over lab data for accuracy, distinguishes between data sources, and provides specific thresholds with dates and version numbers. It instructs to use CrUX field data as more representative and to use lab data only as a fallback, promoting information integrity and proper sourcing.
